linear_trans_color — 2D color op

• Data kinds: color → color

• Call: fullseye.apply(img, "linear_trans_color", a=0.5, b=0.5) (the 2-D model is one image plus two scalar knobs a,b∈[0,1])

• HALCON equivalent: linear_trans_color (the HALCON reference is a useful guide to its meaning and parameters)

Usage

Linearly transforms between channels using a 3x3 mixing matrix (affine color transform). Corresponds to HALCON's `linear_trans_color` (computes an affine transform of color values for a multichannel image) (this implementation is a pure linear transform with no offset term).

> The detailed description below is the original text — the summary and the headings are translated.

対角成分 0.6 + 非対角 0.2 を基本形とし、a で位相 `theta = pi * a` を

振って対角成分の一部を `cos(theta)/sin(theta)` で回転的に変化させた

行列を作り、各行を合計 1 に正規化してから `c @ M.T` を掛ける。

a が 0→1 で R/G 寄りの重みづけが周期的に入れ替わる。b は未使用。
